digests.text: Week in local AI: 156 models captured, 15 new preserved mirrors. Now downloadable: Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct, academic-ds-9B, Seed-OSS-36B-Base, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp….

This week aiarchive.info captured 168 open-weight model repos and mirrored 15, with no alerts or radar signals. Captured families include Qwen (Qwen3.5, Qwen3-VL, Qwen3-Embedding, Qwen-Image), DeepSeek (V3.2, V4-Flash, OCR), Tencent Hunyuan, Xiaomi MiMo, MiniMax, and Wan video models. Mirrored copies now include Baichuan-M3-235B, Yi-6B/34B, Seed-OSS-36B, Qwen3-8B, and DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp.

This week aiarchive.info captured 162 open-weight model repos, including new entries from Qwen (Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Qwen3-ASR-1.7B), DeepSeek (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-OCR-2, DeepSeek-Math-V2), and MiniMax (MiniMax-M3, MiniMax-M3-MXFP8, MiniMax-H3). 15 repos were mirrored, among them Baichuan-M3-235B, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, and several Yi and Seed-OSS checkpoints. No alerts or radar signals were recorded this week.
